name: E1_event_budget_first_v1
source: existing canonical5517 cache through 2026-05-15; original source/cache unchanged
event_birth: First C_t > max(C[t-20:t-1]) when no live event and 5 observed bars have elapsed since prior failure. Missing common-market day breaks knowledge, not inferred halt. Frozen B=prior20 max C, L=prior20 min C, W=B-L, a=mean prior20 TR, Aref=median prior20 amount.
prestructure: Store W/a, last5 low vs previous15 low, last5/previous15 median amount, prior20 signed up/down amount share. Not fitted hard gates; zero W/a or bad prices UNKNOWN.
failure: Prior event tested before new creation: C_t < B-a OR two consecutive closes C<B OR (C_t<B AND A_t>=Aref AND C_t<C_t-1). On failure no same-day new event; cooldown5 observed bars.
confirmation: For t>tau and C_t>B: confirm when either (L_t<=B+0.5a AND A_t<=A_tau) or (C_t>C_tau AND sum_{j=tau+1..t} A_j*sign(C_j-C_j-1)>0). No fixed waiting period; no consecutive-high reset of tau.
buy_intent: Only original native e0/g ready, I_target and i_buy. Original I/CP unchanged. For all live events set S=B-a, T=B+W, next-window price cap Pcap=(T+2*S)/3. Signal candidate only if C_t>B and C_t<=Pcap (RR>=2). Price cap applies again at next observed open; no fill if O>Pcap or O<=S. Target is observable measured-move HYPOTHESIS, not expected return or take-profit order.
queue: Separate PROBE and CONFIRMED queues. Rank RR=(T-C)/(C-S) descending, original PVR descending, sid ascending. Never blend H1/PVR/return/ATR weights. Candidate first-break probing uses 0.25 of a supplied per-name risk unit, confirmed uses1. No accounts or order sizing run. New entry only; no forced exit of existing E0 positions.
market_budget: Breadth B20=mean( C_t>SMA20_t ), same finite universe paired for changes. Risk multiplier 0.25 if B20<0.5 and B20-B20_t-5<=0, otherwise1. Used for prospective risk allowance, not score. Sector classification unavailable PIT; no current-sector backfill or claimed sector validation.
event_path_eval: At earliest admissible next-observed open proxy: fail rule after close implies exit next observed open, bounded at60 common market dates; otherwise terminal close. Also always retain fixed20/60 open-anchor paths, MAE/MFE and early-failure/later-big-path loss. No intraday barrier fills, no T+1 impossible exit. Missing bar makes horizon UNKNOWN. Gap>=3/5pct and flat OHLC flagged only after fact, never preopen filters.
evidence: Already-seen 2022-2026 historical development. Known cases used to motivate all parameters; freezing now does not restore OOS. One rule, no parameter grid, no retrospective retuning.
test_cases: All 5 prior H1 named stocks; all Jan15 seven additions+seven removals; all6 fresh-break exemption examples; all12 PVR benefit/harm example sides. Include negative results without changing formulas.
falsification: Do not promote if it merely recreates H1, filters most early big events, or incurs more failed-break risk per captured big event. Fixed provisional hurdle: >=95% baseline early big-event coverage; <=90% baseline failed-entry downside per event; positive net20/60 event-level improvement after common execution proxy and costs; each complete year direction reported, leave-best-stock/date-block out. These are research gate hypotheses, not promises, and comprehensive comparison requires future work if this bounded mechanism check fails first.
authorization: User explicitly requested computational formula and ranking design and verification; no accounts, no parameter grids.
